fragrances.name: N°5 Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: The quintessential aldehydic floral: a sparkling, soapy-bright opening that softens into powdery jasmine and rose over a creamy sandalwood-vanilla base. It projects a composed, polished glamour that has defined 'perfume' for a century.
cons: Can read dated to younger noses

fragrances.name: N°19
fragrances.description: A cool, crisp green chypre where bitter galbanum gives way to a silvery iris heart and a dry, mossy-leather finish. Poised and self-assured, it suits a confident woman who prefers understatement to sweetness.

fragrances.name: Coco
fragrances.description: A baroque spicy amber of clove, mimosa and resinous labdanum, rich and theatrical yet impeccably tailored. It evokes candlelit dinners and velvet evening wear.

fragrances.name: Shalimar
fragrances.description: The archetypal oriental: a bright bergamot flash melting into smoky, leathery vanilla and resins. Sensual and enveloping, it feels like old-world glamour with a slightly smouldering edge.
cons: Animalic, smoky base can feel old-fashioned

fragrances.name: Mitsouko
fragrances.description: A benchmark fruity chypre in which velvety peach rests on damp oakmoss, spice and woods. Introspective and quietly melancholic, it rewards a wearer who enjoys nuance over immediacy.
cons: Can seem austere to modern tastes

fragrances.name: L'Heure Bleue
fragrances.description: A dusky, wistful blend of anise, heliotrope and iris cushioned by almondy vanilla and balsams. It feels like twilight in an old Parisian salon: tender, nostalgic and softly powdered.

fragrances.name: White Linen
fragrances.description: Starched-sheets freshness: fizzy aldehydes and citrus over crisp white florals and a faint mossy dryness. Clean, bright and orderly, it feels like a pressed white blouse on a sunny morning.

fragrances.name: Youth Dew
fragrances.description: A dense, resinous spice oriental of clove, cinnamon and incense that wraps the wearer like a heavy velvet shawl. Unapologetically rich, it is a cold-weather comfort scent with enormous staying power.

fragrances.name: Trésor
fragrances.description: A plush embrace of rose, apricot and powdery heliotrope sweetened with amber and musk. Warm, romantic and unmistakably feminine, it glows with a soft pink-peach radiance.

fragrances.name: Paris
fragrances.description: Dewy green leaves and mimosa open onto a big, sugared rose-and-violet heart that dries down to a soft powdery musk. Cheerful and openly romantic, it leaves a generous, pink-tinted trail wherever it goes.

fragrances.name: Opium
fragrances.description: An opulent spice-and-resin oriental of clove, plum and myrrh with incense smoke curling through it. Dramatic and seductive, it is made for winter nights and grand entrances.

fragrances.name: J'adore
fragrances.description: A luminous, golden bouquet of jasmine and tuberose softened by juicy pear and a clean musky base. Graceful and polished, it reads as effortless luxury in any setting.

fragrances.name: Poison
fragrances.description: A dark, jammy plum-and-berry potion laced with tuberose, spice and honeyed amber. Bold and theatrical, it is an unforgettable signature for those who want to be noticed.

fragrances.name: Diorissimo
fragrances.description: A dewy, green portrait of lily of the valley in spring bloom, airy and luminous with a faint woody warmth. Delicate and graceful, it feels like a garden stroll on a cool morning.
cons: Current version is lighter than vintage
Hard to find in some markets

fragrances.name: 24 Faubourg
fragrances.description: A sunlit, opulent white floral of gardenia, orange blossom and jasmine resting on warm amber and sandalwood. Luxurious and assured, it carries a quiet-wealth refinement.

fragrances.name: L'Air du Temps
fragrances.description: A soft, clove-tinged carnation floral with a peachy lift and a gentle powdery musk. Tender and romantic, it carries a sense of calm, old-fashioned grace.

fragrances.name: Anaïs Anaïs
fragrances.description: A soft, dewy white-lily floral with a green, powdery veil, innocent and nostalgic. It feels gentle and clean, like fresh flowers in a sunlit room.

fragrances.name: First
fragrances.description: A sparkling aldehydic bouquet of jasmine, rose and narcissus with a jewel-like brilliance and a smooth woody finish. Polished and formal, it suits pearls and evening gloves.

fragrances.name: Aromatics Elixir
fragrances.description: A bold herbal chypre where chamomile and rose meet a deep, earthy patchouli-moss base. Intellectual and commanding, it has a bittersweet, apothecary-like character all its own.

fragrances.name: Red Door
fragrances.description: A full-bodied rose and yellow-floral bouquet warmed with honey and sandalwood. Confident and ladylike, it has the dressed-up feel of an evening at the theatre.

fragrances.name: Portrait of a Lady
fragrances.description: A monumental dark rose saturated with patchouli, incense and berry-tinged spice. Regal and brooding, it projects authority and romance in equal measure.

fragrances.name: Iris Poudre
fragrances.description: Bright aldehydes and bergamot lift a velvety, powdered iris that settles into a creamy vanilla-musk skin. Hushed and sophisticated, it suits a woman who values refinement over volume.

fragrances.name: Infusion d'Iris
fragrances.description: A cool, clean iris softened by neroli and a whisper of incense and vetiver. Serene and polished, it feels like fine cotton and quiet confidence.
cons: Can wear thin on some skin

fragrances.name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Clean, softly powdered rose lifted by peony and a hint of lychee, drying down to pale cedar and a trace of amber. Polished and graceful, it reads distinctly feminine without ever feeling heavy.

fragrances.name: Gold Woman
fragrances.description: A regal aldehydic floral of rose and lily of the valley gilded with frankincense and myrrh. Opulent and ceremonial, it belongs with formal gowns and grand occasions.

fragrances.name: Eau Sauvage
fragrances.description: A crisp, gentlemanly citrus-herbal cologne with a luminous jasmine touch and dry mossy base. Effortlessly refined, it suits linen suits and sunny afternoons.

fragrances.name: Vetiver
fragrances.description: A crisp, earthy vetiver brightened with citrus and a dry whisper of tobacco and spice. Understated and gentlemanly, it suits tailored jackets and quiet confidence.

fragrances.name: Aramis
fragrances.description: A dry, bitter-green leather chypre with herbs, moss and patchouli, confidently masculine and old-world. It evokes wood-panelled studies and well-worn leather armchairs.

fragrances.name: Colonia
fragrances.description: A bright, polished Italian cologne: lemon and bergamot up front, lavender and rosemary in the heart, and a clean vetiver-sandalwood finish. Relaxed but well-dressed, it evokes pressed shirts and long lunches on a summer terrace.
